title: Menu
summary: A list of actions that opens from a button. Use it for the secondary actions of a page, card or table row; use Select to choose a value.

demos.title: Items, labels and shortcuts
demos.note: A label heads a run of items and a separator divides runs. The destructive item is red and sits last, on its own. Arrow keys move one gliding highlight.
